title: CORE (research)
description: Open-access academic papers from CORE as a research source, declared as a service.
setup_notes: Get a free API key at core.ac.uk/services/api. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: scientific, medical, technology, environmental), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; research and Web Search list it by this name.
